name: Ziba AI Content Creator
author: siteziba

sections.description:
Ziba AI Content Creator automates content creation for your WordPress site using modern AI models.

Why Ziba AI?
* No OpenRouter dependency — text generation now uses Pollinations’ free OpenAI-compatible API out of the box.
* Bring your own AI — plug in any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including self-hosted models) with the “Custom” provider.
* MCP-ready — optionally connect a Model Context Protocol endpoint to expose extra tools to the AI.
* WooCommerce integration — generate product titles, descriptions, and SEO meta from the product editor.
* Site-wide generation — works for posts, pages, and products.
* Clean, modern UI — progress bar, live logs, one-click runs.

Content capabilities
* Full article generation (title, body, excerpt, slug, tags, SEO meta).
* Featured image generation (Pollinations or local GD fallback).
* Topic scheduling (manual list or AI-generated topics).
* Internal linking suggestions.

AI providers
* Pollinations (default, free, no API key).
* Any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (user-supplied base URL + API key).
* Optional MCP endpoint for tool-augmented generation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ziba-ai-content-creator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Ziba AI → Settings and configure your provider.
  4. Use the Quick Run button to generate your first article.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. Pollinations is free and works without a key. A key is only required if you choose a custom provider that requires one.

Can I use my own AI model?

Yes. Select “Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint” and enter your base URL, API key, and model name.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. A meta box is added to the product editor for one-click product content generation.

Is MCP supported?

Yes. You can provide an MCP endpoint URL and the plugin will attempt to discover tools via tools/list.

2.2.1

  • Fixed: Fatal Error caused by undefined variable in class-generator.php.
  • Fixed: 404 Model Not Found error by setting default model to “openai”.
  • Fixed: AJAX and Cron timeouts by removing hardcoded sleep() functions.
  • Fixed: WordPress repository readme.txt formatting issues.
  • Improved: Handled 402 Rate Limit retries gracefully.

2.2.0

  • Replaced OpenRouter with Pollinations (OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
  • Added “Custom AI Provider” support (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
  • Added MCP endpoint discovery.
  • Added WooCommerce product content generation.
  • Added site-wide AI content helper.
  • Refreshed admin UI with provider testing, model fetching, and MCP tool discovery.
  • Prepared for WordPress.org submission (readme.txt, uninstall cleanup).

2.1.0

  • Initial public release.
